changelog: Affiliate: campaign tags on the tracked link (`/r/<code>?c=<tag>`, `[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}`, an invalid tag ignored while the click still counts; new counter table `AffiliateClickCampaignDaily`, per partner × UTC day × tag, at most 50 tags per partner and day), a 12-month trend of clicks, registrations and paying customers in the partner portal, and earnings per click (commission in the period ÷ clicks) in the portal and as a sortable column of the admin funnel board. The rules are pure in `src/lib/affiliateTrendRule.ts` and `parseCampaignTag()`; registrations are not split by campaign yet (#3545).

en: Partners can tag their link with ?c= to compare channels, and the partner portal now shows earnings per click and a 12-month trend of clicks, registrations and paying customers.
tr: Partnerler kanallarını karşılaştırmak için linklerine ?c= ile kampanya etiketi ekleyebiliyor; partner portalı artık tıklama başına kazancı ve tıklama, kayıt ve ödeme yapan müşterilerin 12 aylık trendini gösteriyor.
de: Partner können ihren Link mit ?c= markieren, um Kanäle zu vergleichen, und das Partnerportal zeigt jetzt den Verdienst pro Klick und einen 12-Monats-Verlauf von Klicks, Registrierungen und zahlenden Kunden.
